text:
release-lead: Quick bulletin for this week's train — we're instituting a short release window embargo tomorrow 18:00-19:30 PT to apply a config change to our canary gating logic. No full freeze, but new canaries that opt into the new gating will be held until health checks pass.

megan: Clarify: will this block patch hotfixes?

release-lead: Hotfixes allowed but must be flagged as `hotfix/embargo-exempt` in the deploy dashboard. Approvals required: release-lead + sre-oncall.

chris: Can you paste the revised gating thresholds so I can update the runbook?

release-lead: Updated thresholds (effective immediately):
- abort canary if 5xx rate > 0.75% over 3m
- abort if p95 latency > 700ms over 5m
- abort if regression score on smoke set increases > 2.5%
If abort fires: automated steps will scale canary to 0, route traffic to fallback model, and create a rollback ticket in the dashboard.

sre-oncall: How will alerts surface? I want clear paging rules.

release-lead: Alerts go to #eng-oncall and will include `abort-reason` and `deploy-id`. We also added an `--no-confirm` flag to `rdeploy rollback` for oncall use.

ops-bot: Heads up: preflight CI is green for the gating change. Docs updated: https://internal.docs/releases/gating-change.

megan: Please add a 2-line checklist to Release Playbook and a short blurb in the weekly release email. I'll draft the email.

chris: Will Dedicated/pinned pools be impacted? We have long-lived jobs.

release-lead: For Dedicated we prefer variant routing; we will not evict pinned capacity without explicit customer approval. The abort path will attempt routing fallback before teardown.

sre-oncall: I'll be monitoring during the window. If automated rollback doesn't finish within 3min we'll flip to manual.

release-lead: Note the exception flow: create a deploy exception in dashboard, tag `embargo-exception`, include reason + approver. If you need a manual rollback example: `rdeploy rollback --deploy-id DEPLOY_ID --reason "gating-fail"
`

ops-bot: Reminder posted to calendars for those on release/pager list.

megan: Thx — I'll send the email and update playbook now.

release-lead: Thanks all. Flag any infra blockers here; otherwise we'll proceed with the short embargo tomorrow. :rocket:
